footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a $54.1M income tax benefit; after $108M of other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.5% to $15.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 15.7%, versus 15.4% a year earlier, and operating income fell 20.4% to $368M, a 2.4% margin.
Net income fell 45.0% to $119M, or $3.42 per share. Operating cash flow was $567M and free cash flow $717M, versus $296M.
watch: Net income includes a $54.1M tax benefit.
sources: Sonic Automotive, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
